name: Blackfathom Deeps
summary: Blackfathom Deeps is a flooded subterranean temple ruin buried beneath the Zoram Strand along Ashenvale's northwestern coast. Once a glorious house of worship dedicated to the moon goddess Elune, its drowned halls have been overtaken by naga, satyr, and the sinister Twilight's Hammer cult.

sections.title: From Elune's Temple to Darkest Abyss
sections.body: Before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor ten thousand years ago, this complex was a temple dedicated to the goddess Elune, complete with its own moonwell. When the Well of Eternity collapsed, the shrine sank beneath the ocean waves, presumed lost forever. Over millennia, receding shorelines and subterranean shifting left its remains partly flooded beneath the cliffs of Ashenvale.

sections.title: Aku'mai and the Cult
sections.body: In recent years, the corruption of an Old God seeped upward from the deep earth and tainted the temple's sacred Moon Well, and Aku'mai, a monstrous three-headed hydra and servant of the Old God, rose from the waters. The Twilight's Hammer cult established a stronghold within the drowned ruins under the command of Twilight Lord Kelris. Alongside naga headed by Lady Sarevess and prowling satyrs, the cultists sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for power.

faq.q: What was Blackfathom Deeps originally built for?
faq.answer: It was a night elven temple dedicated to the moon goddess Elune, with a sacred moonwell at its heart, before it sank beneath the waves during the Sundering.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer cult here?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer came to worship Aku'mai, a primeval hydra and servant of an Old God. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris, the cult sacrifices innocents to the beast in exchange for dark power.

The entrance is tucked inside cavernous ruins along the Zoram Strand, located on the far northwestern coast of Ashenvale. Adventurers must navigate through submerged chambers and hostile naga outposts to reach the temple portal.
Ghamoo-ra is a giant, maddened turtle that lurks on an island in one of the temple's flooded caverns, attacking any intruder who comes near.

angles.text: The desecration of this ancient temple is a profound grievance for the Kaldorei, who mourn the defilement of a once-sacred shrine of Elune and its moonwell by void cultists and naga.
For the Horde, the deeps lie uncomfortably close to Zoram'gar; the cultists and naga gathering on the Zoram Strand are a threat the outpost's defenders cannot ignore.
